title: Universal Life Insurance Contract Provisions: Partial Withdrawals
content:
**1. Right of withdrawal.** From the tier's first withdrawal policy year, the owner of an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy may withdraw part of the cash surrender value by signed request.

**2. Conditions of payment.** A withdrawal is paid only while the policy status is in force. A withdrawal is paid only on a withdrawal request signed by the owner and approved. Both conditions are read from the company's records: the policy status from the policy record, and the signature and approval from the withdrawal request on the policy's service record.

**3. Limits.** Each withdrawal must be at least the tier's smallest withdrawal; no more than the tier's maximum number of withdrawals may be taken in one policy year, counting the withdrawals taken since the latest policy anniversary; and the cash surrender value remaining after the withdrawal must be at least the tier's minimum remaining cash surrender value.

**4. Fee.** The tier's partial withdrawal fee is deducted from the account value with each withdrawal.

**5. Effect on the face amount.** Under death benefit Option A the face amount is reduced by the withdrawal amount, and the reduced face may not fall below the tier's smallest face amount; under Option B the face amount is unchanged. No surrender charge applies to a withdrawal or to the face reduction it causes.

**6. Taxation and withholding.** On a policy that is not a modified endowment contract, a withdrawal is taxable only to the extent it exceeds the cost basis; on a modified endowment contract, it is taxable first to the extent of the gain. Federal tax is withheld at the tier's default federal withholding rate of the taxable part unless the owner elected no withholding.

**7. No-lapse guarantee.** A withdrawal reduces the no-lapse guarantee premium test.

## Condition checklist

| Condition | Source of the fact | Met when |
|---|---|---|
| Policy year | Issue date | At least the tier's first withdrawal policy year |
| Policy status | Policy record | In force |
| Request | Service record | Signed by the owner and approved |
| Amount | Request | At least the smallest withdrawal |
| Count this policy year | Activity history | Below the yearly maximum before this withdrawal |
| Remaining cash surrender value | Policy values after the withdrawal | At least the minimum remaining value |

## Hypothetical cases

- A policy in the grace period is not paid a withdrawal, the status not being in force.
- Under Option A, a face of $120000.00 on an Ashgrove Accumulation UL (smallest face $50000) is reduced to $110000.00 by a $10000.00 withdrawal; under Option B it stays $120000.00.
- On a policy that is not a modified endowment contract with a cost basis of $40000.00, a withdrawal of $45000.00 is taxable on the $5000.00 by which it exceeds the cost basis; at the default 10%, with no election of no withholding, $500.00 is withheld.
